title: Gas Processing & Compressor Operation: Unauthorized Safety Interlock Jumpering (Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01)
description: During startup of gas compressor Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01 at Gas Compression Plant #2, high pressure ESD trip interlock was found bypassed with an unauthorized electrical bridging clip in the DCS marshalling rack. No Management of Change (MOC) or override risk assessment had been registered.

precursors.equipment: Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01
precursors.unsafe_act: Operator installed temporary wire jumper across high discharge pressure ESD transmitter without MOC
precursors.unsafe_condition: Vibration levels on 3rd stage cylinder escalating above design threshold
precursors.potential_consequence: Catastrophic compressor head explosion and fire

explanation: Critical automated safety safeguard (Emergency Shutdown Interlock) bypassed without engineering authorization.
Leaves high pressure gas processing unit operating without primary overpressure protection.
High potential for catastrophic rupture of gas header under transient surge.
Violates IOGP Bypassing Safety Controls Life-Saving Rule.

title: Vessel Entry & Cleaning: Missing Gas Testing & Standby Watch (Production Test Separator V-101)
description: During vessel cleaning of test separator Production Test Separator V-101 at Early Production Facility Manifold, contractor entered the vessel interior prior to mandatory 4-gas atmospheric testing. Standby hole-watcher was absent from the entry hatch. Continuous forced air ventilation fan had tripped 10 minutes earlier unnoticed.
pattern_cluster: Confined Space Entry Without Gas Test

precursors.unsafe_act: Contractor stepped inside vessel manway without waiting for calibrated gas test results
precursors.unsafe_condition: Sludge residues emitting localized H2S pockets (>25 ppm)
precursors.potential_consequence: Asphyxiation and fatal toxic gas inhalation

explanation: Unauthorized entry into enclosed production vessel containing residual hydrocarbon sludge.
Critical barrier failure: multi-gas testing not performed prior to manway entry.
No qualified standby watchman posted at entry point.
High probability of instantaneous unconsciousness from H2S gas pocket.

title: Pump Maintenance: Isolation Not Verified (Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204)
description: During scheduled pump maintenance on centrifugal booster pump Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204 at Crude Pump Station 3, the technician started disassembling the motor terminal box before confirming complete electrical LOTO isolation. Subsequent multimeter check revealed live 440V supply to the breaker. No physical lockout tag was affixed.

precursors.unsafe_act: Commenced bolt removal and cable disconnect before checking for zero electrical energy
precursors.unsafe_condition: MCC breaker panel lock missing tag and padlocks
precursors.potential_consequence: Arc flash explosion and fatal electrocution

explanation: Maintenance activity initiated on electrical/mechanical pumping system without verified zero-energy state.
Primary administrative barrier (LOTO isolation verification certificate) was bypassed.
Worker was in direct physical proximity to live 440V terminal conductors.
Violates IOGP Energy Isolation mandatory rule.

title: Working at Height: Missing 100% Fall Arrest Tie-Off (Drilling Rig Mast Monkey Board (24m))
description: During tripping pipe operation at Rig-04 Derrick Floor, the derrickman on the monkey board unclipped both harness lanyards simultaneously while moving across racking fingers at 24 meters height. Worker had zero fall protection for approximately 45 seconds over an open drop.

precursors.unsafe_act: Derrickman unhooked twin-tail lanyard while transitioning between fingers without intermediate anchor
precursors.unsafe_condition: Greasy safety harness lanyard and missing intermediate life-line clamp
precursors.potential_consequence: Uncontrolled fatal fall from 24 meters to rig floor

explanation: Work performed at extreme elevation (24m) without positive fall restraint or 100% dual tie-off.
Complete failure of individual fall arrest barrier during elevated pipe racking.
Direct potential for catastrophic fatal blunt force trauma on rig substructure.
Violates IOGP Working at Height Life-Saving Rule.

title: Gas Processing & Compressor Operation: Unauthorized Safety Interlock Jumpering (Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01)
description: During startup of gas compressor Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01 at Gas Compression Plant #2, high pressure ESD trip interlock was found bypassed with an unauthorized electrical bridging clip in the DCS marshalling rack. No Management of Change (MOC) or override risk assessment had been registered.

precursors.equipment: Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01
precursors.unsafe_act: Operator installed temporary wire jumper across high discharge pressure ESD transmitter without MOC
precursors.unsafe_condition: Vibration levels on 3rd stage cylinder escalating above design threshold
precursors.potential_consequence: Catastrophic compressor head explosion and fire

explanation: Critical automated safety safeguard (Emergency Shutdown Interlock) bypassed without engineering authorization.
Leaves high pressure gas processing unit operating without primary overpressure protection.
High potential for catastrophic rupture of gas header under transient surge.
Violates IOGP Bypassing Safety Controls Life-Saving Rule.

title: Hot Work & Welding: Inadequate Hot Work Permit & Missing Fire Blanket (8-inch Crude Trunkline Header)

pattern_cluster: Pipeline Hot Work In Flammable Vapor Zone

precursors.barrier_failure: Inadequate Hot Work Permit & Missing Fire Blanket
precursors.unsafe_act: Welder struck electric arc on flange spool while cold drain line valve was weeping condensate
precursors.unsafe_condition: LEL combustible gas detector alarm setpoint was bypassed; wind blew vapors toward sparks
precursors.potential_consequence: Catastrophic pipeline fire / vapor cloud explosion

explanation: Hot work ignition source introduced in proximity to uncontained flammable hydrocarbon vapors.
Fire watch barrier abandoned and combustible gas testing was overdue.
Active liquid hydrocarbon weeping within the 15-meter hot work exclusion boundary.
Violates IOGP Hot Work Rule.

title: Hot Work & Welding: Inadequate Hot Work Permit & Missing Fire Blanket (8-inch Crude Trunkline Header)
description: During tie-in welding on 8-inch Crude Trunkline Header at Gathering Station GGS-2, sparks landed near an unblinded drain nozzle that had a minor condensate weep. Portable gas monitor had not been re-zeroed and the fire watch had stepped away to fetch water. Flash fire potential was averted when nearby operator shouted to halt.
pattern_cluster: Pipeline Hot Work In Flammable Vapor Zone

precursors.barrier_failure: Inadequate Hot Work Permit & Missing Fire Blanket
precursors.unsafe_act: Welder struck electric arc on flange spool while cold drain line valve was weeping condensate
precursors.unsafe_condition: LEL combustible gas detector alarm setpoint was bypassed; wind blew vapors toward sparks
precursors.potential_consequence: Catastrophic pipeline fire / vapor cloud explosion

explanation: Hot work ignition source introduced in proximity to uncontained flammable hydrocarbon vapors.
Fire watch barrier abandoned and combustible gas testing was overdue.
Active liquid hydrocarbon weeping within the 15-meter hot work exclusion boundary.
Violates IOGP Hot Work Rule.

title: Working at Height: Missing 100% Fall Arrest Tie-Off (Drilling Rig Mast Monkey Board (24m))
description: During tripping pipe operation at Rig-04 Derrick Floor, the derrickman on the monkey board unclipped both harness lanyards simultaneously while moving across racking fingers at 24 meters height. Worker had zero fall protection for approximately 45 seconds over an open drop.

precursors.unsafe_act: Derrickman unhooked twin-tail lanyard while transitioning between fingers without intermediate anchor
precursors.unsafe_condition: Greasy safety harness lanyard and missing intermediate life-line clamp
precursors.potential_consequence: Uncontrolled fatal fall from 24 meters to rig floor

explanation: Work performed at extreme elevation (24m) without positive fall restraint or 100% dual tie-off.
Complete failure of individual fall arrest barrier during elevated pipe racking.
Direct potential for catastrophic fatal blunt force trauma on rig substructure.
Violates IOGP Working at Height Life-Saving Rule.

title: Pump Maintenance: Isolation Not Verified (Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204)
description: During scheduled pump maintenance on centrifugal booster pump Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204 at Crude Pump Station 3, the technician started disassembling the motor terminal box before confirming complete electrical LOTO isolation. Subsequent multimeter check revealed live 440V supply to the breaker. No physical lockout tag was affixed.

precursors.unsafe_act: Commenced bolt removal and cable disconnect before checking for zero electrical energy

precursors.potential_consequence: Arc flash explosion and fatal electrocution

Primary administrative barrier (LOTO isolation verification certificate) was bypassed.
Worker was in direct physical proximity to live 440V terminal conductors.
Violates IOGP Energy Isolation mandatory rule.

title: Working at Height: Missing 100% Fall Arrest Tie-Off (Drilling Rig Mast Monkey Board (24m))
description: During tripping pipe operation at Rig-04 Derrick Floor, the derrickman on the monkey board unclipped both harness lanyards simultaneously while moving across racking fingers at 24 meters height. Worker had zero fall protection for approximately 45 seconds over an open drop.

precursors.unsafe_act: Derrickman unhooked twin-tail lanyard while transitioning between fingers without intermediate anchor
precursors.unsafe_condition: Greasy safety harness lanyard and missing intermediate life-line clamp
precursors.potential_consequence: Uncontrolled fatal fall from 24 meters to rig floor

explanation: Work performed at extreme elevation (24m) without positive fall restraint or 100% dual tie-off.
Complete failure of individual fall arrest barrier during elevated pipe racking.
Direct potential for catastrophic fatal blunt force trauma on rig substructure.
Violates IOGP Working at Height Life-Saving Rule.

title: Pump Maintenance: Isolation Not Verified (Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204)
description: During scheduled pump maintenance on centrifugal booster pump Centrifugal Crude Booster Pump P-204 at Crude Pump Station 3, the technician started disassembling the motor terminal box before confirming complete electrical LOTO isolation. precursors.unsafe_act: Commenced bolt removal and cable disconnect before checking for zero electrical energy

precursors.potential_consequence: Arc flash explosion and fatal electrocution

Primary administrative barrier (LOTO isolation verification certificate) was bypassed.
Worker was in direct physical proximity to live 440V terminal conductors.
Violates IOGP Energy Isolation mandatory rule.

title: Derrick Maintenance & Casing Run: Missing Tool Lanyard & Inadequate Barricading (36-inch Rigid Heavy Pipe Wrench)
description: During casing make-up at Derrick Service Platform (18m), a 7kg pipe wrench slipped off an elevated beam at 18 meters height and plummeted to the rotary floor, impacting 1.5 meters from the driller console. Tool was untethered and red drop-zone barricading tape had not been erected.
pattern_cluster: Overhead Heavy Tool Dropped From Derrick

precursors.unsafe_act: Technician laid heavy 36-inch pipe wrench on un-toeboarded grating edge at 18m without tethering
precursors.unsafe_condition: Severe wind gusts (35 knots) vibrating derrick platform
precursors.potential_consequence: Fatal blunt impact to personnel on rig sub-structure

explanation: Heavy hand tool utilized at elevation without certified secondary retention tether.
Drop zone below active elevated work was not cordoned off.
Kinetic impact energy of dropped object exceeds fatal threshold.
Violates IOGP Dropped Objects Safety Rule.

title: Gas Processing & Compressor Operation: Unauthorized Safety Interlock Jumpering (Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01)
description: During startup of gas compressor Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01 at Gas Compression Plant #2, high pressure ESD trip interlock was found bypassed with an unauthorized electrical bridging clip in the DCS marshalling rack. No Management of Change (MOC) or override risk assessment had been registered.

precursors.equipment: Reciprocating High Pressure Gas Compressor K-01
precursors.unsafe_act: Operator installed temporary wire jumper across high discharge pressure ESD transmitter without MOC
precursors.unsafe_condition: Vibration levels on 3rd stage cylinder escalating above design threshold
precursors.potential_consequence: Catastrophic compressor head explosion and fire

explanation: Critical automated safety safeguard (Emergency Shutdown Interlock) bypassed without engineering authorization.
Leaves high pressure gas processing unit operating without primary overpressure protection.
High potential for catastrophic rupture of gas header under transient surge.
Violates IOGP Bypassing Safety Controls Life-Saving Rule.

title: Vessel Entry & Cleaning: Missing Gas Testing & Standby Watch (Production Test Separator V-101)
description: During vessel cleaning of test separator Production Test Separator V-101 at Early Production Facility Manifold, contractor entered the vessel interior prior to mandatory 4-gas atmospheric testing. Standby hole-watcher was absent from the entry hatch. Continuous forced air ventilation fan had tripped 10 minutes earlier unnoticed.
pattern_cluster: Confined Space Entry Without Gas Test

precursors.unsafe_act: Contractor stepped inside vessel manway without waiting for calibrated gas test results
precursors.unsafe_condition: Sludge residues emitting localized H2S pockets (>25 ppm)
precursors.potential_consequence: Asphyxiation and fatal toxic gas inhalation

explanation: Unauthorized entry into enclosed production vessel containing residual hydrocarbon sludge.
Critical barrier failure: multi-gas testing not performed prior to manway entry.
No qualified standby watchman posted at entry point.
High probability of instantaneous unconsciousness from H2S gas pocket.
